meta.title: The Plan
meta.description: Three draft pledges for Sotik, 2027–2032, each from a documented need.

title: Three pledges. Each starts from a documented need.
draftNote: These pledges are drafts written from public evidence. The campaign will confirm them.

tea.title: A fair price for tea
tea.body: Champion transparent green-leaf pricing and accountable factory boards in Parliament.
tea.why: Bomet tea growers have disputed a green-leaf rate of KSh 23 against the KSh 26 they were promised.

dairy.title: Dairy that pays
dairy.body: Lobby for milk cooling capacity, improved breeds and disease control in every ward.
dairy.why: The county factsheet lists cooling plants, breeds and disease control as Sotik dairy constraints, and high feed costs are behind a milk shortage.

women.title: Women's enterprise
women.body: Open doors to affordable credit and markets for women's groups across all five wards.
women.why: [[TO CONFIRM: sourced statistic on women's groups in Sotik]]
